    mazeengine 1.0.0 API

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    dev.despical.mazeengine
    Plugin lifecycle and the shared entry point for MazeEngine.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.api
    Public contracts for integrating other Bukkit plugins with MazeEngine.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.api.event
    Bukkit events reporting the terminal outcome of accepted maze operations.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.api.model
    Immutable values describing maze identity, coordinates, geometry, and metadata.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.api.operation
    Handles, progress samples, and results for accepted world-editing operations.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.api.request
    Immutable request values for submitting maze creation with preset overrides.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.command
    Command parsing, native argument trees, and player-facing chat panels.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.config
    Validated configuration values, preset codecs, and message presentation.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.core
    Deterministic graph generation, routing, and local maze geometry.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.integration
    Adapters for optional external plugins and original terrain snapshots.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.listener
    Minecraft event guards for saved maze terrain and active operations.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.service
    Coordinates authorized world operations, bounded planning, and persistent maze state.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.service.api
    Connects the public API contracts to the internal world-operation coordinator.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.service.visual
    Manages private preview and route-guide displays for individual players.
    dev.despical.mazeengine.storage
    Persistent maze records, graph validation, and temporary-file replacement.
